name: Stormwind Armor Marker
summary: At Eastvale Logging Camp, Sara Timberlain accepts a Stormwind Armor Marker from those who aid the realm. It lets them claim crafted gear from artisans commissioned by Stormwind.

sections.title: Military Requisitions
sections.body: Stormwind's commanders issue armor markers to those who serve the realm. Keeping order across Elwynn Forest strains Stormwind's resources. So commanders sometimes use these official slips in place of standard gear at military outposts. A marker confirms the bearer's service and allows a contracted local craftsman to provide tailored armor.

sections.title: Eastvale Provisioning
sections.body: Sara Timberlain and other artisans work under commission from the Stormwind Army at Eastvale Logging Camp. The camp lies on Elwynn's eastern frontier, where they use local materials to make protective cloth and leather garments. Present a marker there to receive custom-fitted defense for guarding the surrounding woodlands.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Stormwind Armor Marker?
faq.answer: The Stormwind Armor Marker is an official military voucher for those who aid Stormwind's guards. It proves your service and lets you claim protective armor from an artisan contracted by the army.
Sara Timberlain accepts the marker at Eastvale Logging Camp, just east across the river in Elwynn Forest. She provides tailored cloth and leather equipment under contract with the Stormwind Army.

faq.q: Why does Stormwind use markers instead of handing out armor directly?
faq.answer: Stormwind uses markers because its outlying guard posts may lack the storage, blacksmithing or tailoring setups to outfit recruits on site. Field commanders can send recruits to local artisans like Sara Timberlain, who have dedicated workshops.

faq.q: What kind of equipment does the marker provide?
faq.answer: The marker lets its bearer choose a newly crafted cloth or leather armor piece made to order by an army supplier under contract.

angles.text: As an Alliance member, you can see how Eastvale Logging Camp connects frontier settlements with Stormwind's military command.
